rationale.conceptual: The method is standard DFT with Birch-Murnaghan EOS fitting and Compton profile post-processing, all using proven techniques and common libraries. No novel algorithmic derivation is needed.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises at least five distinct stages: SCF for B1, computation of directional Compton profiles (requiring custom post-processing), anisotropy curve generation, total energy vs. volume scans for two phases, and EOS fitting. Orchestrating these handoffs and handling the Compton profile extraction adds moderate complexity.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires standard DFT calculations for phase transition prediction and Compton profile anisotropy, using widely-used software (Quantum ESPRESSO) and a well-known functional (PBE). The conceptual difficulty is low as the method is textbook; the pipeline involves several sequential steps but remains moderate.

compute_estimate.reasoning: The calculations involve small unit cells and moderate k-point sampling; all runs are CPU-only with modest memory per SCF run. Input data is merely crystal structures, negligible in size.
